How it works

Hand it over. Winkaboo takes it from there.

Whoever holds the phone gets one tip at a time. Whoever is in the photo gets a pose. Winkaboo waits for the moment and takes it.

  1. 01

    Frame it.

    One tip at a time for whoever holds the phone: “2 steps back.” “Phone down to chest height.” A dot drops into its ring when the height, the tilt and the level are right, and a ring on the ground shows your friend where to stand.

  2. 02

    Strike the pose.

    An animated figure shows the pose, and the photographer gets the words to say: “Hands in your pockets… weight on your back leg… look past me.” More than 60 poses, chosen to suit the spot: a wall, steps, a bench, a table, a walk.

  3. 03

    No timer. No countdown.

    When the frame is right, your friend in view with nothing cut off, the phone steady, a face turned to the camera, Winkaboo takes a quick burst by itself, with a wink. The shutter is always there if you’d rather press it.

  4. 04

    Only the best frame.

    Every shot is a quick burst, and Winkaboo keeps its best frame: sharp, eyes open, facing the camera. The backups stay one tap away, in case you’d pick another. No retouching, no beauty scores: it judges the photo, never the person.

  5. 05

    A reel, made for you.

    Take three shots or more and a vertical reel cuts itself, with a peek at how the best one was caught. Save it to Photos or share it.

  6. 06

    Selfies, no button.

    On the front camera, “Eyes here” sits right by the lens, so you look into it, not at yourself. Hold still and the photo takes itself. In a dim room, the screen glows as a soft ring light.

Privacy

Your photos stay on your phone.

  • The camera is read on your iPhone. Nothing it sees is uploaded.
  • Your shots stay in Winkaboo until you save them to Photos or share them.
  • No account, no ads, no tracking. We never sell data.

How Winkaboo works

Winkaboo’s eyes are on your iPhone: Apple’s Vision and Core ML run the models that find the person, read the pose and the framing, and check every frame for sharpness and open eyes. The open models it uses are credited in the app, under Settings › How Winkaboo works. Winkaboo 1.0 sends nothing to any AI provider.

Questions

Do I need an account?

No. There is nothing to sign up for: open Winkaboo and shoot.

Which iPhones does it work on?

Any iPhone with iOS 18 or later. On an iPad it runs as an iPhone app.

Are my photos uploaded?

No. Winkaboo reads the camera on your phone, and your shots stay there until you save them to Photos or share them.

Is it a self-timer?

No timer, no countdown. Winkaboo waits until the frame is right, then takes the shot. You can still press the shutter, or a volume button, any time.

What counts as a shot?

One caught moment, kept as its best frame. Free gives you 5 a day; Winkaboo Unlimited removes the limit.
